module_summary: SERV bit-serial core state controller: a 5-bit cycle counter (3-bit binary o_cnt plus 4-bit one-hot cnt_lsb ring) and an init/run phase flag sequence instruction fetch, register-file requests, bus cycles, branches and traps.

anchors.name: init_done
anchors.why: Two-phase state: first (init) stage done; selects init vs second stage for o_init, bus, rf writes.

anchors.name: o_cnt
anchors.why: Upper 3 bits of the 0-31 bit-serial cycle counter; decoded into cnt outputs and done.

anchors.name: gen_cnt_w_eq_1.cnt_lsb
anchors.why: 4-bit one-hot ring forming counter LSBs, started by i_rf_ready; nonzero gives o_cnt_en.

anchors.name: o_cnt_en
anchors.why: Counter-running enable; gates PC update, bufreg and bus cycle starts.

anchors.name: o_cnt_done
anchors.why: End-of-32-cycle indication; updates init_done, ibus_cyc and jump register.

anchors.name: o_init
anchors.why: Init-stage indication decoded from init_done and two-stage op.

anchors.name: o_ibus_cyc
anchors.why: Instruction fetch request driven from ibus_cyc register.

anchors.name: i_ibus_ack
anchors.why: Instruction bus ack ending fetch and issuing rf read request.

anchors.name: o_dbus_cyc
anchors.why: Data bus cycle request after init for aligned memory ops.

anchors.name: i_dbus_ack
anchors.why: Data bus ack triggering register-file write request.

anchors.name: o_rf_rreq
anchors.why: Register-file read request on fetch ack or trap.

anchors.name: o_rf_wreq
anchors.why: Register-file write request when stage two can begin.

anchors.name: i_rf_ready
anchors.why: Register-file ready; shifted into cnt_lsb to start counting.

anchors.name: trap_pending
anchors.why: Misalignment trap pending; blocks branch rf write and forces rf read.

anchors.name: take_branch
anchors.why: Branch-taken condition from ALU compare; latched into o_ctrl_jump.

anchors.name: last_init
anchors.why: Last cycle of init stage gating rf write and read requests.

anchors.name: gen_csr.misalign_trap_sync_r
anchors.why: Registered misalignment trap flag held until next fetch; drives o_ctrl_trap.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_jump
anchors.why: Branch decision latched at end of init, held through PC update stage.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_trap
anchors.why: Trap mode indication to control unit from ecall, irq or misalignment.

anchors.name: o_bufreg_en
anchors.why: Shift enable for buffer register during mem/branch/shift ops.

anchors.name: o_ctrl_pc_en
anchors.why: PC update enable during counting outside init.

anchors.name: o_cnt0to3
anchors.why: Representative decoded counter-position output (cnt0..cnt12 family).

anchors.name: o_mem_bytecnt
anchors.why: Byte count output taken from o_cnt upper bits for memory lanes.

anchors.name: o_mdu_valid
anchors.why: MDU operation valid; disabled when MDU parameter is zero.

anchors.name: i_mdu_ready
anchors.why: MDU result ready triggering rf write request (MDU builds).

anchors.name: i_two_stage_op
anchors.why: Instruction class needing two stages; enables init stage.

anchors.name: i_branch_op
anchors.why: Branch/jump instruction class steering take_branch and rf write.

groups.name: phase_controller
groups.description: Init/run phase flag, branch and trap decisions sequencing the two-stage instruction flow.

groups.name: bit_counter
groups.description: 0-31 bit-serial cycle counter with decoded position outputs.

groups.name: bus_rf_requests
groups.description: Instruction/data bus cycles, register-file and MDU request handshakes.

groups.name: unit_enables
groups.description: Enables for bufreg, PC update and rf read derived from counter and phase.
